title: "Big Data in R with Arrow"

This short presentation and accompanying reference guide introduces one approach to working with larger-than-memory data analysis in R using the Apache Arrow package `arrow`.

::: {.callout-note icon=false}

## Learning Objectives

- Be able to **explain** why data analysis is faster on data organized in columns over rows. 

:::
